body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

This registers billing's dashboard, billable services page, bill history, visit check-in form and seven modals with `getAsyncLifecycle`, so their code only loads when they're shown. It also adds `react-router-dom` to `peerDependencies`, so billing uses the app shell's copy.

The Billing link renders on the home page, and with `getSyncLifecycle` everything those lifecycles import loaded as soon as the module started. So every session downloaded billing's invoice and forms, along with `zod`, `react-hook-form` and `react-to-print`, before anyone opened anything billing-related. The nav links, left panel links and patient banner tags stay synchronous because they render on other apps' pages.

I built billing from `main` and from this branch, swapped each into a build of today's O3 `next`, and ran the same workflows as the 3.8.0 benchmark: home, the patient chart, visits, clinical forms, the order basket and patient search.

| | `main` | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Billing code loaded when the module starts | 297 KiB | 67 KiB |
| Billing JS loaded across the workflows | 344 KiB | 114 KiB |
| Copies of `react-router-dom` loaded | 2 | 1 |

Sizes are uncompressed. The billing dashboard, billable services, the Add cash point modal, the patient chart's Billing history, and the billing fields in the Start a visit form rendered with no page errors on both builds.

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->

Adds From and To date pickers to the bills table on the Billing home page so cashiers can narrow the list to bills created in a given period. The dates are sent as the `startDate` and `endDate` search parameters on `GET /billing/bill`, which the billing backend added in openmrs/openmrs-module-billing#193.

- `usePaginatedBills` appends `startDate` (start of day) and `endDate` (end of day) to the URL when set.
- The From picker is capped by the To date and the To picker floored by the From date. When a typed range is inverted, `usePaginatedBills` passes a `null` URL so no request is made (the backend would return a 400); the To picker shows an invalid message and the table shows the "No matching bills" state.
- A Clear dates button appears once a date is set and resets both dates.
- The `billing` backend dependency floor in `routes.json` is raised to `>=2.5.0-0`, the first version with the new search parameters.

The **Quantity** field in the "Add bill items" form can't be cleared: emptying it leaves a stuck `0`, and the next keystroke produces a leading zero (e.g. `05`). The `0` also trips the "Quantity must be at least 1" error.

body:

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/docs/frontend-modules/contributing.en-US#contributing-guidelines) label. - [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Creating a new billable service did not refresh the services table.

**Root cause:** The two create launch sites in `billable-services.component.tsx` launched the workspace without the `onWorkspaceClose: mutate` callback that the edit path passes:

- the empty-state launcher → `launchWorkspace2('billable-service-form')`
- the "Add new service" button → `launchWorkspace2('billable-service-form', {})`

The form's `onSubmit` refreshes the parent table only via `onWorkspaceClose()`, which was `undefined` on create. The only fallback was the global `mutate(url)` call in `createBillableService`, but that is unreliable: the table fetches via `useOpenmrsFetchAll` (`useSWRInfinite`), whose aggregated cache is keyed with an internal `$inf$` prefix and is not matched by a plain-URL `mutate`. Edit worked because it passes the hook's bound `mutate`.

**Fix:** Route both create paths through a single launcher that passes the hook's bound `mutate` as `onWorkspaceClose`, matching the edit path.

## Summary

Adds the bill discounts feature to the billing app: cashiers can request percentage or fixed-amount discounts on a whole bill or individual line items, and admins can approve or reject pending requests from a dedicated dashboard. Approved discounts reduce the bill's net amount due and feed through to payment settlement; rejected requests leave the bill total unchanged.

Includes:
- Request-discount modal with client-side validation (percentage cap at 100%, fixed amount can't exceed the line/bill total or push the amount due negative on partially-paid bills).
- Admin "Discount requests" page and review modal with approve/reject flows.
- Invoice page integration: discount/net amount trio, request-discount entry points hidden on PAID/ADJUSTED bills and per-line-item when an existing discount targets the line.

## Screenshots

<!-- Paste the link to the Jira ticket here if one exists. -->

<!-- Anything not covered above —>
This also cleans up the previous bill waiver functionality that we had, because the discount feature was meant to replace it.

### Backend dependency: BillDiscount purge

The e2e spec for the discount workflow (`e2e/specs/bill-discounts.spec.ts`) is **skipped** in this PR. The backend's `BillDiscountResource.purge` currently throws `UnsupportedOperationException`, and the `bill_discount` FK on `cashier_bill_line_item` has no `ON DELETE CASCADE`, so once a bill has a discount the e2e cleanup can't purge it — the test patient and bill leak between runs. The discount-purging helper in `e2e/commands/billing-operations.ts` is commented out for the same reason.

A follow-up PR on `openmrs-module-billing` will add purge support for `BillDiscount` (or cascade the purge from `Bill`). Once that ships, un-skip the spec and uncomment `purgeBillDiscounts` in `deleteBill`.
